_about: Single source of truth for headless runs. One route = one entry here; scripts/headless.py is the only consumer and the only runner. A 'script' route runs a regency script with no model; a 'command' route runs one /regency command through claude -p under a profile; a 'prompt' route takes the Regent's own text. 'refused' records what stays interactive and why (conventions section 15.2). Add a route here, never a new script. Rules: library/automation.md section 2.

read.summary: reads, searches, Claude Code's built-in read-only commands and regency's read-only scripts; every other call is denied, never asked

work.summary: auto mode under library/automode.json; whatever would need a person is denied and reported

preamble: This is a headless regency run: the Regent drives from a shell and reads only your final text. Nobody can answer a question or a permission prompt.
The regency toolkit is at {root}. Read {root}/library/conventions.md once; it binds this run. Find the project's documents with {root}/library/layouts.md.
Run regency scripts exactly as: python {root}/scripts/<name>.py <arguments>.
Route: {route}. Profile: {profile} ({profile_summary}). Stay inside what the route names.

A doubt that does not block goes under 'Doubts' in the reply (conventions section 3); a blocker or a denied action ends the work and is named with what would release it. Never retry a denied action another way.
Never commit, merge or push in a headless run: the Regent reviews the tree and commits interactively.

Reply as plain text for a terminal, no tables wider than 100 columns. First line: '{route} · <verdict> · <one-line summary>'. Then done / left / blocked with percentage and fraction where they apply, then Doubts, then the files you changed, then the assumption line only if something was assumed (conventions section 8).
